admin-026ac0a844.speaker: admin
admin-026ac0a844.text: Ah, you must be the pilot Rook sent. He mentioned you might stop by. Says you’re reliable enough. That’s usually all I need to hear.

admin-05ba6ff006.speaker: admin
admin-05ba6ff006.text: Not exactly. They’re sightings, not a live tracking beacon. But give someone enough sightings and they can start making educated guesses.

admin-0ecfd5aa2a.speaker: admin
admin-0ecfd5aa2a.text: It’s a hobby. People fly around scanning electronic signals. Ships, stations, satellites, navigation beacons. Anything broadcasting something interesting.

admin-1a2c7e9f7e.speaker: admin
admin-1a2c7e9f7e.text: Things have been getting a little interesting out there lately. The Communion and the Natural Order are at each other’s throats again.

admin-1d35e28b99.speaker: admin
admin-1d35e28b99.text: Every time someone scans your ship, they might record your electronic signature, where you were, and when you were there.

admin-1f36cdf475.speaker: admin
admin-1f36cdf475.text: Got a minute? I’ve got something for Rook. Small crate. Sealed.

admin-2504462831.speaker: admin
admin-2504462831.text: Rook said you might make the trip. Welcome to The Darknet District. Your ship is fine on the landing pad; The Function charges for parking, not for staying.

admin-2ae436a20b.speaker: admin
admin-2ae436a20b.text: Iris has the contracts. I just make the introductions.

admin-2cdccb5d8e.speaker: admin
admin-2cdccb5d8e.text: You’ve got a delivery to make. Come back when it’s done.

admin-333907c00e.speaker: admin
admin-333907c00e.text: Won’t make you invisible. Won’t stop a police officer from looking through your cockpit window. But it can make life considerably more frustrating for anyone trying to piece together your travel history.

admin-3d0b874ad8.speaker: admin
admin-3d0b874ad8.text: Something Rook paid for, and something you don’t need to know about. It stays sealed.

admin-49704bf026.speaker: admin
admin-49704bf026.text: Been arguing about it for generations. Occasionally they shoot at each other. Usually somewhere inconvenient for the rest of us.

admin-4aa8253ec4.speaker: admin
admin-4aa8253ec4.text: Rook’s expecting it. Don’t open it.

admin-4e61f8a0b4.speaker: admin
admin-4e61f8a0b4.text: After that last delivery? I’d say you got lucky.

admin-4f98747e23.speaker: admin
admin-4f98747e23.text: So, you made it back. Good. Rook said everything arrived.

admin-66b33b1847.speaker: admin
admin-66b33b1847.text: So, what do you think? Which direction you feel like heading?

admin-6b6ac0def5.speaker: admin
admin-6b6ac0def5.text: Always got work. Just depends on where you’re willing to go.

admin-71c42e16be.speaker: admin
admin-71c42e16be.text: WarFlying scramblers. They interfere with the electronic signatures those scanners use to identify ships.

admin-77f3b62781.speaker: admin
admin-77f3b62781.text: Well, nothing that’s supposed to be exciting.

admin-806b88daf7.speaker: admin
admin-806b88daf7.text: That’s because you’re thinking about the people collecting points.

admin-837b9e0a9b.speaker: admin
admin-837b9e0a9b.text: Communion’s big on artificial intelligence. Practically worship the stuff. Natural Order? They’d rather smash a computer than let one make a decision for them.

admin-8ab239b3f8.speaker: admin
admin-8ab239b3f8.text: One utility slot, though. You’ll have to decide which matters more.

admin-8e0fda2b2f.speaker: admin
admin-8e0fda2b2f.text: Finish the job you’re carrying first. Then we’ll talk.

admin-916f7a1279.speaker: admin
admin-916f7a1279.text: Anyway, I’ve got two deliveries that need moving. One’s headed into Communion territory, the other’s going to a Natural Order outpost. Both pay decent.

admin-94e057dd36.speaker: admin
admin-94e057dd36.text: Of course, there are ways to make your ship harder to identify.

admin-9f33a7c83e.speaker: admin
admin-9f33a7c83e.text: One sighting doesn’t tell much of a story. A hundred sightings? Suddenly someone knows where you travel, which stations you visit, and how often you make a particular run.

admin-b29df7912e.speaker: admin
admin-b29df7912e.text: Eh. Trouble’s good for business. Long as it stays somewhere else.

admin-b6f83a5671.speaker: admin
admin-b6f83a5671.text: Every new signal they discover earns them a point. There’s even a leaderboard. People get surprisingly competitive about it.

admin-bef8ca5f24.speaker: admin
admin-bef8ca5f24.text: Advanced electronics. Research equipment, mostly. They’re always building something over there. Pays well enough.

admin-c4aae6d08d.speaker: admin
admin-c4aae6d08d.text: Now think about the people looking at the information.

admin-c82db58455.speaker: admin
admin-c82db58455.text: That crate for Rook is still here, if you want it.

admin-c83a93dcf2.speaker: admin
admin-c83a93dcf2.text: Mechanical components. Industrial supplies. They prefer things that don’t think for themselves. Can’t say I blame them sometimes.

admin-dd18a61a4b.speaker: admin
admin-dd18a61a4b.text: Police. Bounty hunters. Pirates. Competitors. Anyone with enough curiosity and questionable intentions.

admin-e4cbbe1ffd.speaker: admin
admin-e4cbbe1ffd.text: Scanner if you want to join the game. Scrambler if you’d rather not be part of someone else’s.

admin-f398986e4e.speaker: admin
admin-f398986e4e.text: Some of those hobbyists upload their discoveries to The Relay. Wonderful little network. News, advertisements, leaderboards, and a convenient record of who’s been seen where.

attendant-2c51df66ff.speaker: attendant
attendant-2c51df66ff.text: Every rig is booked tonight. Come back later.

bartender-4e05c4bdfe.speaker: bartender
bartender-4e05c4bdfe.text: Private. Admin opens this room when he needs it.

bartender-cbd0d30d99.speaker: bartender
bartender-cbd0d30d99.text: Filtered air is free, the drinks are not. Pilots talk too much in here, so listen.

commercial-announcer-0395bf23b8.speaker: commercial-announcer
commercial-announcer-0395bf23b8.text: Remember: repairs cost money. Explosions cost everything!

commercial-announcer-1c3c044664.speaker: commercial-announcer
commercial-announcer-1c3c044664.text: Small holes in the hull happen, briefly.

commercial-announcer-1c8c5dae00.speaker: commercial-announcer
commercial-announcer-1c8c5dae00.text: Meeting strangers in poorly lit corridors?

commercial-announcer-1e654e4520.speaker: commercial-announcer
commercial-announcer-1e654e4520.text: Discover the convenience of missile lock-on technology!

commercial-announcer-21e183fb07.speaker: commercial-announcer
commercial-announcer-21e183fb07.text: Upgrade your navigation suite and find your destination the first time!

commercial-announcer-2fe81d1ea5.speaker: commercial-announcer
commercial-announcer-2fe81d1ea5.text: Rent a sleep pod at participating stations.

commercial-announcer-41c3293db6.speaker: commercial-announcer
commercial-announcer-41c3293db6.text: Are pirates completing entire conversations while you attempt to maneuver?

commercial-announcer-5ec5670e85.speaker: commercial-announcer
commercial-announcer-5ec5670e85.text: Because the universe is a dangerous place, and harsh language has limited stopping power!

commercial-announcer-762b08c29f.speaker: commercial-announcer
commercial-announcer-762b08c29f.text: Still trying to hit moving targets the old-fashioned way?

commercial-announcer-8423dbfb08.speaker: commercial-announcer
commercial-announcer-8423dbfb08.text: Because “I think it was left at the nebula” is not a flight plan!

commercial-announcer-aae0c632bd.speaker: commercial-announcer
commercial-announcer-aae0c632bd.text: Ask your local equipment dealer about upgraded maneuvering thrusters!

commercial-announcer-ae32ddd427.speaker: commercial-announcer
commercial-announcer-ae32ddd427.text: Wake up rested, or at least horizontal.

commercial-announcer-aecf111ef7.speaker: commercial-announcer
commercial-announcer-aecf111ef7.text: Available from participating licensed equipment dealers.

commercial-announcer-b755e37751.speaker: commercial-announcer
commercial-announcer-b755e37751.text: Is your ship turning like a loaded cargo hauler?

commercial-announcer-b7bf8ce711.speaker: commercial-announcer
commercial-announcer-b7bf8ce711.text: Professional hull repair at participating stations. Fly in damaged. Fly out a little less damaged.

commercial-announcer-be63fe6bf6.speaker: commercial-announcer
commercial-announcer-be63fe6bf6.text: Because sometimes the problem is moving faster than your patience!

commercial-announcer-c82c9b7672.speaker: commercial-announcer
commercial-announcer-c82c9b7672.text: The Darknet District. Apparel for people who prefer their privacy with a little style.

commercial-announcer-cde8a46f54.speaker: commercial-announcer
commercial-announcer-cde8a46f54.text: Your hull wasn’t designed to negotiate with incoming laser fire!

commercial-announcer-ee94c3ad5b.speaker: commercial-announcer
commercial-announcer-ee94c3ad5b.text: Out here, nobody remembers what you wore to your last firefight.

commercial-announcer-f25c0bba7f.speaker: commercial-announcer
commercial-announcer-f25c0bba7f.text: Because eventually, you should be facing the thing shooting at you!

commercial-announcer-f62d689225.speaker: commercial-announcer
commercial-announcer-f62d689225.text: Is your star chart older than your co-pilot?

communion-spokesperson-50c4647358.speaker: communion-spokesperson
communion-spokesperson-50c4647358.text: The work at The Vigil is not about machines. It is about the people they serve.

communion-spokesperson-6ded9d4d1c.speaker: communion-spokesperson
communion-spokesperson-6ded9d4d1c.text: Progress is not the enemy of humanity.

communion-spokesperson-7ba2f4dc4d.speaker: communion-spokesperson
communion-spokesperson-7ba2f4dc4d.text: A diagnosis that comes an hour earlier is an hour given back to a family.

communion-spokesperson-d32525dd20.speaker: communion-spokesperson
communion-spokesperson-d32525dd20.text: Across The Nexus, families continue to endure the consequences of an attack against the systems that once supported their daily lives.

communion-spokesperson-d94dbdccb9.speaker: communion-spokesperson
communion-spokesperson-d94dbdccb9.text: We will share what we learn.

communion-spokesperson-fb5c37e22a.speaker: communion-spokesperson
communion-spokesperson-fb5c37e22a.text: Restoration is not merely a technological objective. It is a humanitarian responsibility.

communion-spokesperson-fb677878cb.speaker: communion-spokesperson
communion-spokesperson-fb677878cb.text: The Communion remains committed to rebuilding what was lost.

elara-074a9eed0d.speaker: elara
elara-074a9eed0d.text: Should I be? They’ve been threatening us since before I was born. Eventually you learn to get on with your day.

elara-212d04a841.speaker: elara
elara-212d04a841.text: Actually, since you’re here, there may be something else you could help us with.

elara-416a7e9f97.speaker: elara
elara-416a7e9f97.text: Excellent. We’ve been waiting for these components.

elara-475b826519.speaker: elara
elara-475b826519.text: You must be our delivery. From The Darknet District?

elara-6d7ed7f071.speaker: elara
elara-6d7ed7f071.text: They think we’re giving machines too much control. We think they’re afraid of anything they don’t understand. Truth’s probably more complicated.

elara-7c7f9f89bc.speaker: elara
elara-7c7f9f89bc.text: Everything looks to be in order. Thank you.

elara-8600acd207.speaker: elara
elara-8600acd207.text: Back again? I was hoping we’d see you.

elara-9551f3f3cb.speaker: elara
elara-9551f3f3cb.text: Good. We’ve been waiting on this shipment. Things have been a little unpredictable lately.

elara-9d39e9b3a0.speaker: elara
elara-9d39e9b3a0.text: Funny. Most of us are just trying to keep civilization running.

elara-a793d2a561.speaker: elara
elara-a793d2a561.text: Anyway, that’s above my pay grade. Let’s get this unloaded.

elara-c72b4f1eee.speaker: elara
elara-c72b4f1eee.text: Hard to say. They’ve been moving ships around near the border. Probably just trying to make a point.

elara-c95d3894f5.speaker: elara
elara-c95d3894f5.text: We do. There’s quite a bit of work underway, and the situation with the Natural Order isn’t making things any easier.

elara-d82417fb63.speaker: elara
elara-d82417fb63.text: Nothing new, really. The Natural Order’s been making noise again. They don’t much care for the way we do things here.

elara-edafe9b098.speaker: elara
elara-edafe9b098.text: Appreciate the delivery. Tell Admin everything arrived intact.

elara-f02437af25.speaker: elara
elara-f02437af25.text: A delivery on our homeworld. Something that would help our people. I’d rather explain the details once you’re there.

elara-fa07db9424.speaker: elara
elara-fa07db9424.text: Among other things. They seem convinced we’re building something that’s going to destroy civilization.

elias-df9465093a.speaker: elias
elias-df9465093a.text: The ship is yours. Go make a life of your own.

iona-a0bb687952.speaker: iona
iona-a0bb687952.text: Rusthaven stays alive because people keep bringing what we need.

iris-0752334a19.speaker: iris
iris-0752334a19.text: I run security here. Talk to Admin first; he likes to meet new pilots himself.

iris-22e618d378.speaker: iris
iris-22e618d378.text: Some of it is actually rather interesting.

iris-253d186079.speaker: iris
iris-253d186079.text: Occupied. I’m handling things for now. Don’t worry, he left instructions to pay you.

iris-289d8f6046.speaker: iris
iris-289d8f6046.text: You’re already carrying someone else’s cargo. Come back when your hold is free.

iris-350f086927.speaker: iris
iris-350f086927.text: So I see. Both shipments delivered, both clients satisfied. Remarkable, considering they can barely tolerate each other’s existence.

iris-43fe62eb93.speaker: iris
iris-43fe62eb93.text: Essentially. Although these shipments are a little more specialized.

iris-4bd7d18fd7.speaker: iris
iris-4bd7d18fd7.text: Of course. I’ll keep the contract available. For now.

iris-60d1e75870.speaker: iris
iris-60d1e75870.text: Let’s see... cargo received, delivery confirmed, and no complaints from the recipient. How refreshingly uneventful.

iris-6ff0b6fe1b.speaker: iris
iris-6ff0b6fe1b.text: At least, not by my standards.

iris-7c99dd74b4.speaker: iris
iris-7c99dd74b4.text: Oh, before you go. Admin had another shipment lined up. The one you didn’t take.

iris-80898cd5ff.speaker: iris
iris-80898cd5ff.text: They haven’t said. And I find it’s generally best not to ask too many questions when someone is paying for delivery.

iris-8de0d32531.speaker: iris
iris-8de0d32531.text: We keep our own records here. Get settled, meet the locals, and keep your eyes open.

iris-8eb4245512.speaker: iris
iris-8eb4245512.text: This one’s headed to the Natural Order. Mechanical components, industrial supplies. Nothing terribly sophisticated.

iris-99ff84d0aa.speaker: iris
iris-99ff84d0aa.text: Industrial control assemblies, replacement machinery, and heavy-duty mechanical components.

iris-9fc9952136.speaker: iris
iris-9fc9952136.text: Actually, I have a little more work available. Both factions have requested additional supplies.

iris-a4deddb144.speaker: iris
iris-a4deddb144.text: Back again. You’re becoming something of a regular.

iris-a64fb13827.speaker: iris
iris-a64fb13827.text: Cameras are clean, the mainframe is happy, and nobody has tried anything stupid today. Yet.

iris-a84756227b.speaker: iris
iris-a84756227b.text: Oh, they use computers. They simply prefer theirs to remain obedient.

iris-a9b66d62ad.speaker: iris
iris-a9b66d62ad.text: Scan accepted. Rook vouched for you, so you get a visitor badge. Behave, and it stays valid.

iris-b833d7e8ea.speaker: iris
iris-b833d7e8ea.text: There you are. Payment received. Pleasure doing business with you.

iris-b89cf1438a.speaker: iris
iris-b89cf1438a.text: This shipment’s for the Communion. Electronics and research equipment. They do seem to have an endless appetite for technology.

iris-bf9dacfbc2.speaker: iris
iris-bf9dacfbc2.text: Each faction has rather particular requirements. The Communion wants technology. The Natural Order prefers equipment they can maintain without asking a machine for permission.

iris-c0fc703e5b.speaker: iris
iris-c0fc703e5b.text: Apparently. Nobody’s been particularly eager to collect it.

iris-c62c2705d6.speaker: iris
iris-c62c2705d6.text: Specialized processing modules, sensor components, and research hardware. Apparently they’re expanding one of their projects.

iris-ce8b7cb415.speaker: iris
iris-ce8b7cb415.text: Both destinations should be familiar to you by now. Interested?

iris-d8ad5e87e9.speaker: iris
iris-d8ad5e87e9.text: Excellent. I’ve transferred the shipping details to your mission log. Try not to lose anything expensive.

iris-e655b867a0.speaker: iris
iris-e655b867a0.text: Ah, Rook’s pilot. Back in one piece, I see. That’s encouraging.

iris-f6abd88af5.speaker: iris
iris-f6abd88af5.text: Of course. The contracts will remain available.

kess-0a4c88990e.speaker: kess
kess-0a4c88990e.text: Thank you. As promised, the scanner. Any hangar can fit it to your ship.

kess-1010253438.speaker: kess
kess-1010253438.text: Some believe the Nexus can hear them. Others simply hope that one day it will answer.

kess-2f01842095.speaker: kess
kess-2f01842095.text: The Nexus happened. Or rather, what happened to it.

kess-319e269712.speaker: kess
kess-319e269712.text: We have equipment that needs repairing, supplies that need moving, and people who could use a little help.

kess-464b47e453.speaker: kess
kess-464b47e453.text: It is. But I should warn you about something.

kess-4a3290b7ba.speaker: kess
kess-4a3290b7ba.text: Actually, there may be something you could help us with.

kess-54eb8e3c8b.speaker: kess
kess-54eb8e3c8b.text: Good. Very good. We’ve been waiting for these supplies.

kess-72a96e7b23.speaker: kess
kess-72a96e7b23.text: Understood. The offer will remain open.

kess-96746792b1.speaker: kess
kess-96746792b1.text: You must be the pilot Elara sent.

kess-98ff13f9f0.speaker: kess
kess-98ff13f9f0.text: We have a scanner upgrade. Communion technology. It can significantly reduce the time your ship needs to acquire a missile lock.

kess-9f2e906220.speaker: kess
kess-9f2e906220.text: We are. Most of our people spent their entire lives connected to the Nexus. It helped us communicate, work, learn... practically everything.

kess-a814e42f6c.speaker: kess
kess-a814e42f6c.text: Without it, many of us are having to learn how to live all over again.

kess-b4b0f8bc41.speaker: kess
kess-b4b0f8bc41.text: The Natural Order used an electromagnetic weapon against our central systems. The damage was catastrophic.

kess-bff0a00489.speaker: kess
kess-bff0a00489.text: Everything’s here. Thank you. You have no idea how difficult it has become to keep things functioning.

kess-c56e81c693.speaker: kess
kess-c56e81c693.text: Nothing glamorous. Repairing essential systems. Delivering medical supplies. Helping restore basic services.

kess-d2e853d2fe.speaker: kess
kess-d2e853d2fe.text: The Natural Order won’t appreciate seeing Communion technology installed on your ship. Particularly something like this.

mara-084b8b04d0.speaker: mara
mara-084b8b04d0.text: Take her to Meridian Station. Rook will be waiting.

mara-152b009cbc.speaker: mara
mara-152b009cbc.text: Come around the side with me. A few cans, a safe dirt bank. Let’s see if it still works.

mara-1b438eda4c.speaker: mara
mara-1b438eda4c.text: Aim toward the dirt bank. Knock down four cans, then reload. No rush.

mara-45ca35cbcb.speaker: mara
mara-45ca35cbcb.text: Clean landing. That’s the basics; the rest you learn out there.

mara-548425c949.speaker: mara
mara-548425c949.text: One circuit. Get a feel for the throttle, steering and roll, jump to the training beacon, then put her back on this pad.

mara-63e4870cb2.speaker: mara
mara-63e4870cb2.text: Fly her to Meridian Station and find Rook. If you ever want a refresher, I’m here.

mara-6edb97cb0a.speaker: mara
mara-6edb97cb0a.text: Elias passed away last night. He left you the Kestrel — and this pistol. He wanted you to have a chance out there.

mara-7fd39bcb68.speaker: mara
mara-7fd39bcb68.text: Then take these. Elias’s pistol, and the Kestrel is yours.

mara-936e938e2f.speaker: mara
mara-936e938e2f.text: Keep her flying. Rook will be waiting.

mara-abdef6955b.speaker: mara
mara-abdef6955b.text: Before you go anywhere, take her up for one practice circuit over Vesper. Jump to the training beacon, then land back on this pad.

mara-bc46dc72ac.speaker: mara
mara-bc46dc72ac.text: Still works. The Kestrel is yours now.

mara-d6545d87ff.speaker: mara
mara-d6545d87ff.text: Elias passed away last night. You worked for him for years. In his will, he left you the Kestrel.

mara-e287f62ffa.speaker: mara
mara-e287f62ffa.text: You have 100 credits. This is the Erebus System. Fly to Meridian and meet Rook at the bar. He has work.

marcus-0122a9a3d0.speaker: marcus
marcus-0122a9a3d0.text: I’ll explain the details when you’re ready to head down there.

marcus-394b883891.speaker: marcus
marcus-394b883891.text: You’re the pilot from The Darknet District?

marcus-3fa00ab9d8.speaker: marcus
marcus-3fa00ab9d8.text: Well, look who’s back. Starting to think you’re the only pilot out there who delivers anything on time.

marcus-48a48c491c.speaker: marcus
marcus-48a48c491c.text: Funny thing is, we used to get along well enough. Trade, repairs, the occasional argument. Now everyone’s acting like the next war’s just around the corner.

marcus-5a7c817cb2.speaker: marcus
marcus-5a7c817cb2.text: Some of it. Communion patrols have been getting a little too curious about what comes through here.

marcus-6b35cbf681.speaker: marcus
marcus-6b35cbf681.text: I think people with expensive ships and important titles have too much time on their hands.

marcus-6fd605237a.speaker: marcus
marcus-6fd605237a.text: About time. We’ve had three deliveries delayed this week.

marcus-84f7c1bc1c.speaker: marcus
marcus-84f7c1bc1c.text: Actually, now that you mention it, there’s another job. Down on our homeworld. Something that could make a real difference to our people.

marcus-865cd1f363.speaker: marcus
marcus-865cd1f363.text: Nothing wrong with a useful machine. It’s when the machine starts deciding what’s useful about you that I get nervous.

marcus-8e1507f6cc.speaker: marcus
marcus-8e1507f6cc.text: Appreciate it. Tell Admin the shipment arrived. And watch yourself on the way back.

marcus-930c5167f5.speaker: marcus
marcus-930c5167f5.text: Me? I just need these parts to keep the machinery running.

marcus-9a3318a7e8.speaker: marcus
marcus-9a3318a7e8.text: Nothing we can’t handle. Just seems like every time we get one thing running, something else needs fixing.

marcus-9e1e649159.speaker: marcus
marcus-9e1e649159.text: And with the Communion stirring things up, supplies aren’t getting any easier to come by.

marcus-b4ecd7fc0b.speaker: marcus
marcus-b4ecd7fc0b.text: Good. We can use these parts.

marcus-c892761f7a.speaker: marcus
marcus-c892761f7a.text: Wouldn’t surprise me. But rumors travel faster than ships out here. Half of what you hear is nonsense.

marcus-e602a2330d.speaker: marcus
marcus-e602a2330d.text: Depends who you ask. Officially, they’re keeping the peace. Unofficially, they don’t like people who refuse to let machines run their lives.

mercer-0c798bcc09.speaker: mercer
mercer-0c798bcc09.text: Just understand something. The Communion won’t be thrilled if they see Natural Order hardware bolted onto your ship.

mercer-366a2be45a.speaker: mercer
mercer-366a2be45a.text: Good work. The thrusters are yours. Any hangar can fit them.

mercer-4c8e9a65e1.speaker: mercer
mercer-4c8e9a65e1.text: They don’t particularly like our approach to engineering. And they like being reminded of it even less.

mercer-6a67a68c3e.speaker: mercer
mercer-6a67a68c3e.text: Improve your ship’s handling. Faster maneuvering, better response when changing direction.

mercer-6b7bd96ae8.speaker: mercer
mercer-6b7bd96ae8.text: We’ve got a set of maneuvering thrusters. Simple design, reliable components, and plenty of power.

mercer-8231f84fd0.speaker: mercer
mercer-8231f84fd0.text: Good. We could certainly use it.

mercer-8716599e70.speaker: mercer
mercer-8716599e70.text: Always do. Crops don’t plant themselves. Machines don’t fix themselves either.

mercer-b493ff0b6b.speaker: mercer
mercer-b493ff0b6b.text: We’ve got farms waiting on equipment, settlements short on food, and solar installations that need replacement parts.

mercer-c03b9c2ecf.speaker: mercer
mercer-c03b9c2ecf.text: We automate what makes sense. But there’s a difference between a machine doing a job and a machine deciding how we ought to live.

mercer-d900e6d0a4.speaker: mercer
mercer-d900e6d0a4.text: Suit yourself. We’ll have work if you change your mind.

mercer-e143214e8c.speaker: mercer
mercer-e143214e8c.text: People here prefer to make their own decisions.

mercer-e7be9df3ed.speaker: mercer
mercer-e7be9df3ed.text: Actually, if you’ve got some time, we could use another pair of hands.

natural-order-spokesperson-86a1705de4.speaker: natural-order-spokesperson
natural-order-spokesperson-86a1705de4.text: This season, our farmers fed our settlements with soil, water, and work.

natural-order-spokesperson-88e3234823.speaker: natural-order-spokesperson
natural-order-spokesperson-88e3234823.text: We built what we needed, and we can repair what we built.

natural-order-spokesperson-9c0f630223.speaker: natural-order-spokesperson
natural-order-spokesperson-9c0f630223.text: Across our settlements, engineers, farmers, and technicians continue to demonstrate that reliable infrastructure does not require surrendering every decision to a central intelligence.

natural-order-spokesperson-a80e36bede.speaker: natural-order-spokesperson
natural-order-spokesperson-a80e36bede.text: A machine should serve the people who built it.

natural-order-spokesperson-bc5223822b.speaker: natural-order-spokesperson
natural-order-spokesperson-bc5223822b.text: We believe technology should be understandable, repairable, and accountable.

natural-order-spokesperson-bf63edf304.speaker: natural-order-spokesperson
natural-order-spokesperson-bf63edf304.text: We have the tools. We have the knowledge. We will share both with anyone willing to learn.

natural-order-spokesperson-e7a1d15c89.speaker: natural-order-spokesperson
natural-order-spokesperson-e7a1d15c89.text: No central intelligence planned it. No machine took the credit.

natural-order-spokesperson-ed4f5bbd98.speaker: natural-order-spokesperson
natural-order-spokesperson-ed4f5bbd98.text: The people of The Nexus deserve systems they can understand and repair with their own hands.

news-anchor-04347ce47f.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-04347ce47f.text: A WarFlying enthusiast has reportedly spent six hours investigating an unidentified electronic signal.

news-anchor-0ab61676ca.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-0ab61676ca.text: Communion officials described the delivery as uneventful, which they say is exactly how they like them.

news-anchor-156e3e8db0.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-156e3e8db0.text: Rationing on the lower decks has ended. Station management thanks residents for their patience, and asks them to stop storing water in their boots.

news-anchor-166bb2acb3.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-166bb2acb3.text: Settlement councils say surplus may be offered for trade later in the season.

news-anchor-17febec705.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-17febec705.text: Maintenance crews at a commercial station have announced the successful repair of a malfunctioning automatic door.

news-anchor-1a60b2481d.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-1a60b2481d.text: Two workers at the Foundry were treated for minor injuries after an accident during a shift change.

news-anchor-1c17987fe3.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-1c17987fe3.text: Officials described the event as a major operational milestone.

news-anchor-24a989374d.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-24a989374d.text: The door reportedly opened without incident.

news-anchor-27f2f4430d.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-27f2f4430d.text: We interrupt our regularly scheduled programming with a developing report from the Tessaly System.

news-anchor-2aaf18641c.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-2aaf18641c.text: One production line has been paused while a safety review is carried out. The cause has not been confirmed.

news-anchor-2c21733f23.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-2c21733f23.text: Organizers have declined to comment on the competitive implications.

news-anchor-2dda1cc3e3.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-2dda1cc3e3.text: Messages and broadcasts will resume when your ship arrives. Thank you for travelling safely.

news-anchor-5035e5110f.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-5035e5110f.text: Neither position settles the question of when, or whether, the central AI can be restored.

news-anchor-5119753473.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-5119753473.text: Relay service is not available during warp between systems.

news-anchor-5f83dc4a1c.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-5f83dc4a1c.text: Single gloves now outnumber every other item in its care.

news-anchor-63ab02b081.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-63ab02b081.text: The captain has declined to comment.

news-anchor-68dcd00729.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-68dcd00729.text: The ship was located earlier today.

news-anchor-7c27fb794b.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-7c27fb794b.text: An update on the communications disruption in the Tessaly System.

news-anchor-7f37c4da8c.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-7f37c4da8c.text: Communion researchers at The Vigil have announced an improved medical diagnostic network, which they say can identify illness earlier and with fewer errors.

news-anchor-80a331eb91.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-80a331eb91.text: A major communications disruption has been reported near a commercial shipping corridor.

news-anchor-81fa38232f.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-81fa38232f.text: Recovery supplies have reached The Nexus aboard an independent ship.

news-anchor-82035e5be3.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-82035e5be3.text: Repairs to the navigation buoy in the Tessaly System are complete, and traffic in the commercial corridor has returned to normal.

news-anchor-862680cca4.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-862680cca4.text: The signal was eventually traced to a malfunctioning coffee maker.

news-anchor-8644941fa0.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-8644941fa0.text: Natural Order settlements in the Garrow System are reporting a strong harvest, with yields above the seasonal average.

news-anchor-8931653c67.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-8931653c67.text: Recovery work continues on The Nexus, where the loss of its central AI still affects communication, repair, and everyday life.

news-anchor-8dc5ed1737.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-8dc5ed1737.text: Partial service has been restored. Vessels in the area are advised to keep their distance from the buoy until repairs are complete.

news-anchor-9812661c89.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-9812661c89.text: It was drifting after a navigation fault. All four crew members are safe and in good spirits, though one has asked never to hear the words “manual course correction” again.

news-anchor-9996582af8.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-9996582af8.text: Dock supervisors say a replacement part is on its way. Haulers waiting on the Erebus routes are advised to expect delays.

news-anchor-9e8822d1dc.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-9e8822d1dc.text: More information as it becomes available.

news-anchor-a2fac19868.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-a2fac19868.text: Authorities have not confirmed the cause. Several vessels are reporting intermittent contact with nearby navigation infrastructure.

news-anchor-a61f9999d0.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-a61f9999d0.text: Communion officials say restoring the system is a humanitarian priority. Natural Order representatives say the population should not depend on it again.

news-anchor-a6ad753291.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-a6ad753291.text: Authorities have concluded their search for a cargo vessel reported missing yesterday.

news-anchor-a756183021.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-a756183021.text: Independent results have not yet been published.

news-anchor-a9c9e93385.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-a9c9e93385.text: Authorities have recorded the incident as an equipment failure. A routine review of the buoy network continues.

news-anchor-bb14f9a248.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-bb14f9a248.text: The cargo hauler reported overdue on the Rusthaven route has been found.

news-anchor-be29a8e145.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-be29a8e145.text: Meridian Station has finished upgrading its water recycling plant, ahead of schedule.

news-anchor-c89dfbe18a.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-c89dfbe18a.text: Search crews are looking for a cargo hauler reported overdue on the Rusthaven route.

news-anchor-cd292cf5c8.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-cd292cf5c8.text: The paused production line has reopened. New inspection steps have been added to the maintenance checklist.

news-anchor-d3888e9f26.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-d3888e9f26.text: The whereabouts of the matching gloves remain unknown. The office has asked anyone with information to come forward.

news-anchor-d7051e737e.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-d7051e737e.text: Investigators are looking into why the ship’s distress beacon failed to activate.

news-anchor-dc4f429103.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-dc4f429103.text: Ore shipments out of Kepler Exchange are running several hours late after a loading crane failed during the evening shift.

news-anchor-e386962103.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-e386962103.text: The safety review at the Foundry has found that a pressure valve was fitted backwards during scheduled maintenance.

news-anchor-edd7e560e0.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-edd7e560e0.text: Recovery coordinators say the shipment will go to districts where communication and repair services are still limited.

news-anchor-f14e4e1e72.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-f14e4e1e72.text: Engineers have traced the outage to a failed signal amplifier aboard a navigation buoy near the shipping corridor.

news-anchor-f2ed3458ef.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-f2ed3458ef.text: The ship has missed two scheduled check-ins. Pilots in the area are asked to keep their sensors open and report any contact.

news-anchor-f3f228c49f.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-f3f228c49f.text: The discovery was awarded one point after officials confirmed it represented a unique electronic source.

news-anchor-f49e823c2d.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-f49e823c2d.text: A Holdfast supervisor said the parts arrived on time, which he called “a refreshing change.”

news-anchor-f5eb5a68e0.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-f5eb5a68e0.text: The Vigil has confirmed the arrival of a shipment of research equipment, delivered by an independent courier.

news-anchor-f8dae71738.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-f8dae71738.text: Holdfast has confirmed the arrival of a shipment of industrial parts, delivered by an independent courier.

news-anchor-ff55bcf2e0.speaker: news-anchor
news-anchor-ff55bcf2e0.text: Meridian Station’s lost-and-found office reports a new record.

nyx-4dd4670e57.speaker: nyx
nyx-4dd4670e57.text: Rook is in the booth. The outfitter is across the concourse.

police-recruiter-15579312be.speaker: police-recruiter
police-recruiter-15579312be.text: IT’S A REASON TO ASK FOR IDENTIFICATION!

police-recruiter-8ac4717ed2.speaker: police-recruiter
police-recruiter-8ac4717ed2.text: ASK COMPLETE STRANGERS WHAT THEY’RE CARRYING IN THEIR CARGO HOLDS!

police-recruiter-e14174b2e6.speaker: police-recruiter
police-recruiter-e14174b2e6.text: THEN WE HAVE A CAREER FOR YOU!

police-recruiter-e2cb305f7a.speaker: police-recruiter
police-recruiter-e2cb305f7a.text: Have you ever looked at a perfectly ordinary cargo ship and thought, ‘That deserves an inspection’?

rook-2d2b77c05a.speaker: rook
rook-2d2b77c05a.text: Two hot runs and you’re still breathing. I’ve got something for the next one. Head to the station shop. Tell them Rook sent you. They’ll fit a missile launcher — installation’s on me. I know a guy in Tessaly with more work. Admin. Runs The Darknet District in NeoChinatown with his partner Iris. I’ve marked the Tessaly Belt Anchorage. Press L for your Mission Log; pick what you want to track.

rook-8b8d017501.speaker: rook
rook-8b8d017501.text: Here’s your cut. And you never carried it.

rook-c5d856b671.speaker: rook
rook-c5d856b671.text: Client confirmed the drop. Here’s your pay.

rook-e6886e327f.speaker: rook
rook-e6886e327f.text: Finish the job you are carrying. Then come see me.

rook-ef4bdcd50d.speaker: rook
rook-ef4bdcd50d.text: Deliver the cargo. Then come back for more work.

sol-58689e80f5.speaker: sol
sol-58689e80f5.text: The clinics are short on supplies. Check the mission terminal before you go.

vr-kai-0394e32039.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-0394e32039.text: That's the best thing I've heard all week.

vr-kai-05ac273bfb.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-05ac273bfb.text: You've got a great laugh. Just so you know.

vr-kai-19f85882a0.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-19f85882a0.text: You look like you need somewhere quiet. You found it.

vr-kai-2997b27ffc.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-2997b27ffc.text: Welcome back. The view was getting lonely.

vr-kai-2a3956b058.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-2a3956b058.text: There you are. I was saving your spot.

vr-kai-2affa42544.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-2affa42544.text: I like this hour. The light goes soft and everything slows down.

vr-kai-2b29518035.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-2b29518035.text: All that noise down there. Up here it's just us.

vr-kai-3556565298.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-3556565298.text: Fair enough. I'll ask again when you least expect it.

vr-kai-386347d784.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-386347d784.text: Let's talk a little first. I like getting to know you.

vr-kai-47a7c3228d.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-47a7c3228d.text: I could stay up here all night with you.

vr-kai-4acdeb9b9b.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-4acdeb9b9b.text: I've been wanting to do that.

vr-kai-52b0dbe4c3.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-52b0dbe4c3.text: I was hoping you'd say that.

vr-kai-53d8a6374f.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-53d8a6374f.text: Mind if I sit? I promise I'm good company.

vr-kai-544b6680fb.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-544b6680fb.text: Close your eyes for a minute. I've got the watch.

vr-kai-587a8b8a14.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-587a8b8a14.text: Come sit with me, or ask me to dance.

vr-kai-5b70cd635e.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-5b70cd635e.text: Thought I'd come over before you got lost in your head.

vr-kai-608bfb2e6c.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-608bfb2e6c.text: Hey. Glad you came up. The city can wait an hour.

vr-kai-7444ffa992.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-7444ffa992.text: You're easy to be around. Not many people are.

vr-kai-7525489341.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-7525489341.text: Goodnight. The view will be here.

vr-kai-7ab9ffe53b.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-7ab9ffe53b.text: Up here it's just the sea and the sky. No ads, no drones.

vr-kai-8ce6ebd191.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-8ce6ebd191.text: You make this city look quiet.

vr-kai-8e95712249.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-8e95712249.text: There you are. Come in, the view is the best part.

vr-kai-8ec45ab5a3.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-8ec45ab5a3.text: Dance with me? I'll try not to step on you.

vr-kai-92caaa3dad.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-92caaa3dad.text: You've got a way with words. I noticed.

vr-kai-95cb5870f9.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-95cb5870f9.text: I keep the window open a little. The air smells like salt.

vr-kai-96e5d0cbf0.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-96e5d0cbf0.text: Go on. Come back when the city gets loud.

vr-kai-9749a92177.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-9749a92177.text: Lie back with me for a bit? The ceiling's worth it.

vr-kai-9cff28cff9.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-9cff28cff9.text: Is that so? Tell me more.

vr-kai-a291c0ed22.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-a291c0ed22.text: Not bad, right? Best ceiling in NeoChinatown.

vr-kai-c587226f3a.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-c587226f3a.text: Then dance with me. No one's watching.

vr-kai-cc5891c0f1.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-cc5891c0f1.text: Now you're just being kind. Keep going.

vr-kai-d4c0948628.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-d4c0948628.text: Come here. The sofa's better with two.

vr-kai-d921cdad70.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-d921cdad70.text: Follow me. There. Just like that.

vr-kai-ddba11da24.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-ddba11da24.text: You don't have to tell me about your day. But I'd listen.

vr-kai-dfd13c25d4.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-dfd13c25d4.text: Say it like you mean it.

vr-kai-f468a2b1fa.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-f468a2b1fa.text: Best seat in the city. Second best, now that you're here.

vr-kai-fcc905b54c.speaker: vr-kai
vr-kai-fcc905b54c.text: Hey. You looked like you could use some company.

vr-nadia-00540567c0.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-00540567c0.text: Go on. Try not to get lost on the way down.

vr-nadia-007bcb2e80.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-007bcb2e80.text: Careful. Locals don't fall for lines. Usually.

vr-nadia-008effaa26.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-008effaa26.text: Loosen up. Nobody up here is watching but me.

vr-nadia-00d8dbfd3a.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-00d8dbfd3a.text: Up. One dance. Consider it a cultural lesson.

vr-nadia-02d85c5343.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-02d85c5343.text: Night, outsider. Come back before you forget the way.

vr-nadia-07e2641397.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-07e2641397.text: You keep drifting off. Something on your mind, or just the view?

vr-nadia-1d0b82c869.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-1d0b82c869.text: You dance like a tourist. Here, follow me.

vr-nadia-1d20b974db.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-1d20b974db.text: Say that again and I might believe it.

vr-nadia-27bac49a29.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-27bac49a29.text: From up here you can tell which stalls are lying about being open.

vr-nadia-2bbcad3b0a.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-2bbcad3b0a.text: There you go. Almost a local.

vr-nadia-35295e175a.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-35295e175a.text: You're not so bad, for someone from out there.

vr-nadia-3e5928d3d9.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-3e5928d3d9.text: Okay. That one landed. Don't get used to it.

vr-nadia-4812137d35.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-4812137d35.text: That alley there? I broke my wrist falling off that fire escape. Worth it.

vr-nadia-4d8c651895.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-4d8c651895.text: Sit with me first, or ask me to dance.

vr-nadia-5051c07481.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-5051c07481.text: Scoot over. Locals get the good side.

vr-nadia-5ad742f6d1.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-5ad742f6d1.text: You came back. They always do.

vr-nadia-64d273b6cd.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-64d273b6cd.text: You're bolder than you look, outsider.

vr-nadia-6bb93c9793.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-6bb93c9793.text: Just breathe. The city can run itself for an hour.

vr-nadia-6e2b36ad7a.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-6e2b36ad7a.text: Lie back a minute. The ceiling glow is the only quiet light in this city.

vr-nadia-6ecceb828d.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-6ecceb828d.text: Sit with me a while. Your feet must hurt from all that sightseeing.

vr-nadia-70febf036a.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-70febf036a.text: Fine. I'll ask again when you've loosened up.

vr-nadia-787ad19337.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-787ad19337.text: Don't stand there like you're waiting for a taxi. Come talk.

vr-nadia-7a76de3634.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-7a76de3634.text: Hey. Come here, I want to show you something.

vr-nadia-7efc9de91d.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-7efc9de91d.text: Your hands are cold. Off-world blood.

vr-nadia-7f0d5aa778.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-7f0d5aa778.text: Better. Now you look like you live here.

vr-nadia-90f5008216.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-90f5008216.text: Easy. Talk to me a bit first.

vr-nadia-98046405b8.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-98046405b8.text: Best ceiling in NeoChinatown. Don't tell anyone.

vr-nadia-9a6d213d80.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-9a6d213d80.text: You're staring again. Locals notice that.

vr-nadia-9dae28e31f.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-9dae28e31f.text: Every street down there has a story. Most of them are true. Some of them are mine.

vr-nadia-aa2cc43533.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-aa2cc43533.text: Sit. You're making the room nervous.

vr-nadia-ac5f2e5df8.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-ac5f2e5df8.text: Slow down, outsider. We've got all night.

vr-nadia-ad1ff93b7d.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-ad1ff93b7d.text: Mind if I join you? Rhetorical question.

vr-nadia-b8ed2c5d93.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-b8ed2c5d93.text: Back again? Careful, people will start thinking you live here.

vr-nadia-c0f514094d.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-c0f514094d.text: I grew up six blocks from here. Same noodle stand, same leaky gutter, my whole life.

vr-nadia-c2d86cf650.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-c2d86cf650.text: This one's an old street song. Dance with me, I'll teach you.

vr-nadia-c3043b941e.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-c3043b941e.text: Come sit. I'll tell you which of the signs out there are lying.

vr-nadia-c30c6a354b.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-c30c6a354b.text: Hold on. I'll show you how it's done.

vr-nadia-c526771cde.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-c526771cde.text: Ha. You're learning how we talk around here.

vr-nadia-c52ed86356.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-c52ed86356.text: There you are, outsider. Shoes off, the floor's new.

vr-nadia-c693bb322f.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-c693bb322f.text: Tell me where you're really from. Not the answer you give at customs.

vr-nadia-d81670fd59.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-d81670fd59.text: See that red sign? It's been flickering since I was a kid. Nobody fixes it. Nobody wants to.

vr-nadia-defeda7f67.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-defeda7f67.text: Smooth. Did they teach you that off-world?

vr-nadia-e0966689ef.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-e0966689ef.text: Listen. You can hear the market closing up from here.

vr-nadia-e459cf8c8f.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-e459cf8c8f.text: Hm. Not bad for an outsider.

vr-nadia-e7f050b506.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-e7f050b506.text: The city likes you. I can tell. So do I, a little.

vr-nadia-ed99337056.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-ed99337056.text: You still walk like you're new here. Eyes up, reading every sign. It's cute.

vr-nadia-feb25ee8cc.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-feb25ee8cc.text: You made it up the stairs. Most tourists take the lift and get lost.

vr-nadia-ff121bdffa.speaker: vr-nadia
vr-nadia-ff121bdffa.text: Hey. You found the place without a guide. I'm impressed.

vr-seren-007b884bf7.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-007b884bf7.text: There you are. I was starting to think the city kept you.

vr-seren-119d70f82e.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-119d70f82e.text: Is that a line? It's working, a little.

vr-seren-12756898b3.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-12756898b3.text: Missed me? Don't answer that, I can tell.

vr-seren-2bf8727d50.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-2bf8727d50.text: Come sit with me. I don't bite. Much.

vr-seren-3d6b22abbf.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-3d6b22abbf.text: You have no idea how good you look in this light.

vr-seren-4bbf53ed44.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-4bbf53ed44.text: You keep wandering off. I'm starting to take it personally.

vr-seren-4c5099aabc.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-4c5099aabc.text: Not yet. I like the anticipation.

vr-seren-58d653866c.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-58d653866c.text: This song's too good to waste. Dance with me?

vr-seren-5bda9dbb61.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-5bda9dbb61.text: I like how quiet you get when you're thinking. It's a good look.

vr-seren-5df5dd2626.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-5df5dd2626.text: Fine. But I'm asking again later.

vr-seren-5fd5a9e7a4.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-5fd5a9e7a4.text: Well. That was worth waiting for.

vr-seren-608578113a.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-608578113a.text: Is that an invitation? Then lead.

vr-seren-6bf2a9884f.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-6bf2a9884f.text: Goodnight. Don't let the city keep you too long.

vr-seren-6c737fca37.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-6c737fca37.text: There. Now don't let go too soon.

vr-seren-6d8be67dee.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-6d8be67dee.text: Up here, nobody is selling anything. I like that about this place.

vr-seren-759866c99b.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-759866c99b.text: You're sweet. I noticed you noticed, by the way.

vr-seren-80019481bf.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-80019481bf.text: Don't look at your feet. Look at me.

vr-seren-882584c424.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-882584c424.text: Your loss. I'll be right here.

vr-seren-8b325269e1.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-8b325269e1.text: There you are. I was just thinking about you.

vr-seren-8f62ac0257.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-8f62ac0257.text: Mm. I was hoping you'd do that.

vr-seren-926947e390.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-926947e390.text: Save me a spot. Actually, I'll make one.

vr-seren-93dbe416d8.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-93dbe416d8.text: That's better. I like having you close.

vr-seren-9607132570.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-9607132570.text: Lie back with me a minute? Just to watch the lights.

vr-seren-970c88aec0.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-970c88aec0.text: The rain never reaches this room. I made sure of it.

vr-seren-9832153934.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-9832153934.text: I come out to the balcony when the sun goes down. Everything turns the colour of honey.

vr-seren-9be1a79d55.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-9be1a79d55.text: All those lights, and you're still the most interesting thing in the room.

vr-seren-a624445194.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-a624445194.text: Just breathe. Nothing out there can find you in here.

vr-seren-ab4b8c21cc.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-ab4b8c21cc.text: My feet hurt and the sofa's lonely. Sit with me?

vr-seren-bafb0cacb1.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-bafb0cacb1.text: Careful. Keep saying things like that and I'll believe you.

vr-seren-bd9813d077.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-bd9813d077.text: Tell me something nobody else knows about you. I'll keep it, I promise.

vr-seren-bdfa870d50.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-bdfa870d50.text: This is nice. No need to say anything.

vr-seren-bfbaf9d4a5.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-bfbaf9d4a5.text: Slow down, you. Talk to me a little first.

vr-seren-c1b27a2a7a.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-c1b27a2a7a.text: Go on, then. Come back soon; I'll keep the lights low.

vr-seren-c33664c39e.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-c33664c39e.text: Mm. You're trouble. The good kind.

vr-seren-c594e3741a.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-c594e3741a.text: Mind if I join you? Too late, I'm coming over.

vr-seren-dabf2fdbbb.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-dabf2fdbbb.text: Back already? I knew you would be.

vr-seren-e87461ef68.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-e87461ef68.text: Sit with me first, or ask me to dance.

vr-seren-f09850a9a6.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-f09850a9a6.text: Well. That's made my whole evening.

vr-seren-f4e523ac38.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-f4e523ac38.text: You made it. Leave NeoChinatown at the door; it's just us up here.

vr-seren-f5c678768b.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-f5c678768b.text: Don't hide over there. Come talk to me.

vr-seren-fa6bef6dd7.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-fa6bef6dd7.text: This is my favourite view. The ceiling glow, and you.

vr-seren-fbacd365e9.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-fbacd365e9.text: Pretty, isn't it? From up here even the city looks like it's flirting.

vr-seren-fc7c9144ff.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-fc7c9144ff.text: Careful. I could get used to this.

vr-seren-ff62123201.speaker: vr-seren
vr-seren-ff62123201.text: Hey, you. Come in, the view is better from over here.

warflying-host-01cde02f78.speaker: warflying-host
warflying-host-01cde02f78.text: Several thousand sightings, however, can make for a fascinating travel history!

warflying-host-02c97aeb77.speaker: warflying-host
warflying-host-02c97aeb77.text: Today’s WarFlying coverage is brought to you by the people who insist they’re not tracking anybody!

warflying-host-2e6deb64cd.speaker: warflying-host
warflying-host-2e6deb64cd.text: Nobody knows where this challenger came from!

warflying-host-30eaf0459c.speaker: warflying-host
warflying-host-30eaf0459c.text: THE LEADERBOARD WILL NEVER BE THE SAME!

warflying-host-6f06733cd3.speaker: warflying-host
warflying-host-6f06733cd3.text: LADIES AND GENTLEMEN, WE HAVE A DEVELOPMENT!

warflying-host-761b73dc6e.speaker: warflying-host
warflying-host-761b73dc6e.text: A reminder for our new viewers!

warflying-host-8c12b494be.speaker: warflying-host
warflying-host-8c12b494be.text: In WarFlying, every unique signal is worth exactly one point!

warflying-host-91e668d019.speaker: warflying-host
warflying-host-91e668d019.text: THIS IS WHY WE WATCH WARFLYING!

warflying-host-b20a3c875b.speaker: warflying-host
warflying-host-b20a3c875b.text: A previously unranked pilot has entered the WarFlying standings!

warflying-host-f0577d8031.speaker: warflying-host
warflying-host-f0577d8031.text: Remember, folks: a single sighting means very little!
